whyMatters.title: Why the 'See More' Button Matters
whyMatters.content:
LinkedIn's algorithm heavily weighs 'dwell time' - how long users spend on your post. If your hook doesn't compel users to click 'See More', your post gets deprioritized. Studies show that posts with strong hooks get 3-5x more engagement than those with weak openings.

The first 3 lines on mobile (5 on desktop) are your only chance to capture attention. This tool shows you exactly what users see before they decide to engage or scroll past.

methodology.title: Our Methodology
methodology.content:
We analyzed thousands of viral LinkedIn posts to identify patterns in successful hooks. Our scoring algorithm evaluates:

- Power word usage (words that trigger curiosity and emotion)
- Hook length optimization (shorter is often better)
- First line impact (does it stop the scroll?)
- Question vs. statement effectiveness
- Number and statistic inclusion

Other tools charge $10/month for this functionality. We provide it free because we believe growth should be accessible to everyone.

whyMatters.title: Why Posting Time Matters
whyMatters.content:
Social media algorithms favor posts that get quick initial engagement. If you post when your audience is offline, your content gets buried before anyone sees it.

Our data shows that posts published at optimal times receive 2-4x more impressions and engagement compared to random posting. The first 30-60 minutes after posting are crucial for algorithmic distribution.

methodology.title: Our Methodology
methodology.content:
We analyzed millions of posts across LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and Instagram to identify engagement patterns by industry. Our database is updated regularly to reflect changing user behaviors.

Key factors we consider:
- Peak activity hours by platform
- Industry-specific audience behavior
- Day of week patterns
- Timezone distribution of your target audience

While individual results may vary, these times represent the statistical best windows for maximum reach.
